verdict.rationale: Anomaly and duplicate monitoring is a fair question for accounting software, so the axis applies. Wave's evidence shows only adjacent features: auto-merge and categorization of bank transactions, month-to-month report comparisons for spotting trends, and an undocumented GraphQL endpoint that is at most a developer building block. Nothing documents an agent or automated feature that monitors the ledger and flags spend anomalies or duplicate transactions before close.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can have an agent monitor the ledger and flag anomalies in spend or duplicate transactions before the close
